title: NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit: Bead Purification of Ligation Reaction
author: Opentrons
materials: NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit

This protocol uses multi-channel P20 and P300 pipettes to perform library prep steps on 8-48 input total RNA samples according to the attached NEB user guide. This is part-5 of a six part process (bead purification of the ligation reaction). User-determined parameters are available to specify the number of samples and the magnet engage height and time. ---
The protocol will alert the user to ensure reagents are present on deck in sufficient volume.
The magnets will disengage for elution.
The magnets will engage to pellet the beads.

steps.title: Pre‑cool temperature module
steps.instruction: Use the OT‑2 app to set the temperature module in slot 1 to 4 °C before starting the protocol.

steps.title: Verify reagent volumes on deck
steps.instruction: Confirm that all required reagents (NEBNext Sample Purification Beads, 80 % ethanol, 0.1X TE, etc.) are present on the deck in sufficient volume; the protocol will prompt the user to check.

steps.title: Add purification beads to cDNA
steps.instruction: With the P300 multi‑channel pipette, dispense the NEBNext Sample Purification Beads into each adapter‑ligated cDNA sample in the magnetic module plate and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Incubate bead mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate on‑deck for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Engage magnets and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module at the user‑specified height and time to pellet the beads, then use the P300 multi‑channel pipette to remove and discard the supernatant from each well.

steps.title: Wash bead pellets with ethanol
steps.instruction: Wash the bead pellets twice with 80 % ethanol using the P300 multi‑channel pipette.

substeps.instruction: Add 80 % ethanol, mix, and remove the ethanol (first wash).
Add 80 % ethanol again, mix, and remove the ethanol (second wash).

steps.title: Air‑dry bead pellets
steps.instruction: Allow the beads to air‑dry on the deck until the ethanol evaporates; the OT‑2 will pause for this step.

steps.title: Disengage magnets for elution
steps.instruction: Turn off the magnetic module to release the beads for elution.

steps.title: Resuspend beads in 0.1X TE
steps.instruction: Using the P20 multi‑channel pipette, add 0.1X TE buffer to each well and mix to fully resuspend the beads.

steps.title: Re‑engage magnets to pellet beads
steps.instruction: Re‑engage the magnetic module at the user‑specified height and time to re‑pellet the beads.

steps.title: Recover eluate to output plate
steps.instruction: With the P20 multi‑channel pipette, transfer the cleared eluate from each well to the designated output plate.
